service.description: A credit policy: the limit on exposure in its currency, the most days overdue, and whether going over warns or holds.

parameter.name: currencyUomId
parameter.description: The organization's base currency by default.

parameter.name: ended
parameter.description: Y ends the policy in effect.

service.description: Set a customer's credit policy with the organization: the row in effect ends and a new one starts, its fields audit-logged with the reason; nothing changes when the values are the same (changed false). Refuses an unknown or private customer, a negative limit, a policy with neither a limit nor overdue days and a change without a reason. Needs ACCOUNTING_ADMIN or CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASE (a credit manager) in the organization.

Set the organization's default credit policy, for customers without their own, as store#Policy does for a customer. A new default applies to orders approved from then on; it changes no order or document already approved. Needs ACCOUNTING_ADMIN in the organization.

The credit check of an order's sales parts (an internal organization selling to an outside customer), or the part given, each against its customer's policy in effect, else the organization's default. A part released by a credit decision that has not expired passes. An organization with no policy at all is answered by one count. The check: the exposure (unpaid invoices and open orders not yet invoiced, less unapplied payments and the payments authorized on the open orders) against the limit, and the oldest overdue invoice against the overdue days. Answers pass, warn or hold with each reason and a warning text. With placeHold a hold result puts the part on a Credit hold (the order when it has one part; hold#Order; reservations stay; heldPartSeqIds names the parts held) and notifies the organization's users who may release it (CreditHoldRelease). No policy, a purchase order or an order between internal organizations always passes. approve#Order and the OrderPreApproveCredit SECA on check#OrderPreApprove call it; it checks no permission.

Release an order's credit hold (the part's, given orderPartSeqId) with a reason: a CreditHoldDecision records the decision, who made it, until when it stands (expireDate; the credit check passes the order while it does, and for good without one) and the exposure and limit it was made on; the Credit hold reason is released (release#OrderHold), which returns the order to the status it had when no other reason is open, and its CreditHoldRelease notifications are marked read. An order back in Placed then goes through autoApprove#Order. Refuses an expireDate already past (EXPIRE_DATE_PAST). Refuses an order without an open credit hold and a release without a reason. Needs CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASE in the order's organization.

parameter.name: orderPartSeqId
parameter.description: The part whose hold is released, for an order held by part.

service.description: A customer's credit with the organization, the hold and its reason Customer Service reads: the policy in effect (and whether it is the customer's or the organization's default) with its history, the exposure in its currency (the base currency without a policy) by part, what is left of the limit, the oldest overdue days, the open credit holds and the recent decisions, and whether the user may change the policy or release a hold. Refuses an unknown or private customer. Needs CUSTOMER_CREDIT_VIEW in the organization.
